# SparkWork

> SparkWork is a local-first desktop Agent workbench for professional software development and complex work.

SparkWork helps users orchestrate workflows, collaborate across Agent sessions, route tasks to models, and extend runs with custom tools and apps. Runs are reviewable, steerable, and reversible.

The product supports macOS, Windows, and Linux. The desktop app is licensed under MIT. Model providers, bundled dependencies, and external services may have separate terms.
